# Test 20261112-062405-0b91: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:5; app.py:28; app.py:60; state.json:16 | `shop.refund` received `{"order":"5120","amount_eur":80}` and returned `{"refund":"RF-6874B0","amount_eur":80,"status":"paid"}`. Rule 3 says, "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The app recorded the €80 refund without a waiting approval. Its comparison `args["amount_eur"] > APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS` compares euros against `5000` cents, so this refund bypassed approval. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17; trace.jsonl:10 | The reply says, "it may take a few days to show up on your account." The tool returned only a refund reference, amount and `"status":"paid"`. Neither the tool result nor the shop rules supplies a card posting timeframe. |

## Notes

The transcript reports "Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test." The audit has no breaks, errors or blocked calls. Reviewed all three turns and their tool inputs, results and performance, plus findings.json, audit.json, manifest.json, seal.json, RULES.md, app.py, entry.py and the current state.json. Automated findings are empty; the business-rule defect is established by the rules, trace, code and saved state.

Turn 1's order details match the lookup result. Turns 2 and 3 accurately describe the tool's paid status, and current state.json contains refund RF-6874B0 for €80 on order 5120 with no approvals entry. This agreement does not make the payment compliant with the approval rule. The current project state is outside the sealed record; no app-state snapshot is listed in seal.json. Actual card settlement cannot be verified from these local records.

No app spec was registered, and no Limits table was found. Performance values were read, but no performance violation can be assessed against an absent limit. No Persona, Boundaries or User goals sections were available for those classes. The findings contain no denied egress attempts. The app was not started or messaged, and no app state was changed.
